Search Twitter YouTube Facebook Instagram Flickr LinkedIn BLM Eastern States Mining and Minerals Surface lands within the jurisdiction of the BLM Eastern States are primarily acquired lands by the Federal Government and managed by other agencies. Mining claims for locatable minerals may not be staked on most of these lands, but there are scattered areas in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Florida where mining claims may be staked (or “located”) for hard rock minerals. Public domain lands within BLM Eastern States are not open to the location of mining claims. All Federal minerals are within the jurisdiction of the BLM, whether they may be on public domain or acquired lands. There is, however, one exception: the Ouachita National Forest in Arkansas is authorized to manage quartz mining by contracts under P.L.100-446 Sec.323. For more information, please visit the Forest Service's Minerals & Geology webpage . An example of mining in the Eastern States is the Doe Run mining complex in southeastern Missouri, which consists of several mines and Federal mineral lease and generates the largest hard rock royalty in the United States. They regarded the specialised unit as a "death house" as not many patients do recover - especially those admitted in the late stages of the illness. His 50-year-old mother was in tears, pleading with him not to go there. "Why are you choosing to die at the Ebola treatment centre?" Masika Ndungo had asked him. But as a doctor at Butembo's Katwa Hospital, he knew that if stayed at home, he was unlikely to survive. This was in July, two months after the World Health Organization (WHO) had declared the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo a public health emergency of international concern. Since then 5,400 people have died and 11,000 have been infected, making it the second-most deadly outbreak ever recorded. Butembo is in North Kivu province, the epicentre of the crisis, with the highest number of reported cases, according to the Congolese health ministry. pages.text: Edmonia Lewis confronted American slavery in her sculptures. Then history forgot her. | National Geographic Premium HISTORY & CULTURE Edmonia Lewis confronted American slavery in her sculptures. Then history forgot her. A new exhibition of her masterworks is traveling the country and reclaiming her place in American history. During her lifetime, Edmonia Lewis was America's most famous artists. Seen here, the biracial sculptor defied the odds and produced trailblazing work. Augustus Marshall, Courtesy Smithsonian National Museum of African American History and Culture By Katy Kelleher Published June 15, 2026 Part celebrity, part anomaly, sculptor Edmonia Lewis captivated mid-19 th -century audiences with her luminous, large-scale marble sculptures that appeared nearly lifelike in their carefully rendered detail. For wealthy Americans on the Grand Tour, a stop at her studio was practically necessary. But visitors weren’t just there to follow in the footsteps of Pope Pius IX and President Ulysses S. Grant, both admirers of Lewis, they were there to obtain proof. They wanted to see with their own eyes that Lewis, a petite biracial woman, could render life from stone. For some, it beggared belief that her hands could have coaxed forth vivid expressions from blocks of Carrara marble. While she was able to delegate some of the brute work of carving to assistants, Lewis made a point of ensuring that the public saw her with a chisel in hand, an unusual choice for sculptors of the era. Even in the prime of her storied career, Lewis still needed to prove herself, to justify her talent

Not all fish, shellfish, or the insects that they eat can tolerate the same amount of acid. An ecosystem is a community of plants, animals and other organisms along with their environment including the air, water and soil. Everything in an ecosystem is connected. If something harms one part of an ecosystem – one species of plant or animal, the soil or the water – it can have an impact on everything else. Effects of Acid Rain on Fish and Wildlife The ecological effects of acid rain are most clearly seen in aquatic environments, such as streams, lakes, and marshes where it can be harmful to fish and other wildlife. As it flows through the soil, acidic rain water can leach aluminum from soil clay particles and then flow into streams and lakes. pages.title: EFTPS: El Sistema de Pago Electrónico del Impuesto Federal | Internal Revenue Service
pages.description: Use el sistema de pago electrónico del impuesto federal (EFTPS) para pagar sus impuestos. Pague a través del sitio web seguro o por teléfono usando el sistema de respuesta de voz de EFTPS.
pages.text: EFTPS: El Sistema de Pago Electrónico del Impuesto Federal | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content EFTPS: El Sistema de Pago Electrónico del Impuesto Federal English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen Más en Pagar Cuenta bancaria (Pago directo) Tarjeta de crédito o débito Su Cuenta en línea Pago de impuestos de negocio (EFTPS) Plan de pagos Ayuda para la deuda tributaria Multas Intereses Retención de impuestos Pagos electrónicos extranjeros Cargos administrativos No se aceptan nuevas inscripciones para contribuyentes que son personas físicas. Los contribuyentes que son personas físicas ya no pueden crear nuevas cuentas EFTPS. Pague la mayoría de sus impuestos de persona física a través de su cuenta en línea . Para los tipos de pago menos comunes, ahora el pago directo (Direct Pay) acepta pagos mediante formularios adicionales . Los usuarios actuales de EFTPS pueden seguir utilizándolo por el momento. EFTPS (en inglés) es un sistema que se ofrece gratuitamente a través del Departamento del Tesoro de los Estados Unidos para pagar sus impuestos federales. El EFTPS ofrece... Seguridad en la que usted puede confiar El uso de su número de identificación del contribuyente (número de identificación del empleador ( EIN , por sus siglas en inglés) o número de Seguro Social ( SSN , por sus siglas en inglés)), el número de identificación personal (PIN, por sus siglas en inglés) y una contraseña de Internet, junto con un navegador de Internet seguro, aumenta su seguridad. Conveniencia al alcance de su mano Programe pagos con hasta 365 días de adelanto.

pages.text: EFTPS: Hệ thống Thanh toán thuế Liên bang bằng điện tử | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content EFTPS: Hệ thống Thanh toán thuế Liên bang bằng điện tử English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In Thanh toán tự chọn và khả năng chuyển nhượng Tài khoản ngân hàng (Direct Pay) Thẻ ghi nợ hoặc thẻ tín dụng Tài khoản trực tuyến của bạn Thanh toán thuế doanh nghiệp (EFTPS) Kế hoạch thanh toán Trợ giúp nợ thuế Hình phạt Tiền lãi Khấu lưu thuế Thanh toán điện tử từ nước ngoài Phí sử dụng (tiếng Anh) Không có ghi danh mới cho người đóng thuế cá nhân Người đóng thuế cá nhân không thể tạo tài khoản EFTPS mới nữa. Thanh toán hầu hết các loại thuế cá nhân thông qua Tài khoản trực tuyến của bạn. Đối với các loại hình thanh toán ít phổ biến hơn, Direct Pay hiện chấp nhận thanh toán trên các mẫu đơn bổ sung . Người dùng EFTPS hiện tại vẫn có thể sử dụng EFTPS vào lúc này. EFTPS (tiếng Anh) là một hệ thống miễn phí do Bộ Tài chính Hoa Kỳ cung cấp để trả tiền thuế liên bang của bạn. EFTPS cung cấp Sự bảo mật mà bạn có thể tin cậy Việc sử dụng Mã số thuế ( EIN hoặc SSN ), Mã số cá nhân (PIN) và Mật khẩu Internet, cùng với trình duyệt Internet an toàn, sẽ tăng tính bảo mật cho bạn. Sự thuận tiện nằm trong tầm tay của bạn Lên lịch thanh toán trước tối đa 365 ngày. Thanh toán tiền thuế của bạn từ nhà hoặc văn phòng, 24/7. Trả thuế thu nhập, thuế việc làm, thuế ước tính và thuế gián thu liên bang. Dễ dàng thay đổi hoặc hủy bỏ các khoản thanh toán theo lịch. Theo dõi việc thanh toán của bạn bằng các thông báo qua email. pages.text: EFTPS：联邦电子缴税系统 | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content EFTPS：联邦电子缴税系统 English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In 您的在线账户 银行账户 (Direct Pay) 借记卡或信用卡 您的在线账户 企业税付款（联邦电子缴税系统 (EFTPS)） 付款计划 税务债务帮助 罚款 利息 预扣税（英文） 国外电子付款 用户费用（英文） 不再接受新的个人纳税人注册 个人纳税人不能再创建新的联电子缴税系统 (EFTPS) 账户。大多数个人税款通过您的 在线账户 支付。对于不太常见的支付类型，“ 直接支付 ”现在接受 更多表格 的支付。现有的 EFTPS 用户仍然可以使用 EFTPS。 EFTPS (英文) 是由美国财政部提供用来缴纳您的联邦税的免费系统。 EFTPS 提供 您可以信赖的安全性 使用您的纳税人识别号码（ EIN 或 SSN ）、个人识别号码 （ PIN ） 和互联网密码，以及安全的互联网浏览器，可提高您的安全性。 触手可及的便利 提前 365 天来安排付款。 您可以一周七天，一天 24 小时从家里或办公室进行缴税。 缴付所得税、就业税、预估税和工商联邦税。 轻松更改或取消设定的付款。 通过电子邮件通知追踪您的付款。 查看 15 个月的付款历史记录。 向客户服务部了解付款帮助，或洽询问题。 您可以信赖的准确性 您的付款会收到立即确认，您的银行对帐单将确认付款已支付。 能够为多个客户付款 如果您是税务专业人士，您可以在一次登录下为多个客户付款。 下载免费的批量提供商软件（英文） 。 5301号刊物，联邦电子缴税系统 -- 批量提供商软件用户手册（英文） PDF 如何注册EFTPS EFTPS 的新注册最多可能需要五个工作日才能处理。 在 EFTPS 注册（英文） 或向 EFTPS 客户服务部索取注册登记表格： 800-555-4477 877-333-8292 (联邦政府机构) 800-733-4829 ( TDD 听障专线) 800-244-4829 (西班牙语) 使用 EFTPS 的额外好处 通过 EFTPS 语音回复系统付款选项： 800-555-3453 使用 常见问题（ FAQ ）(英文) 功能获得即时资讯 注册后，可使用 "如何"(英文) 功能（需要注册） 下载 EFTPS 文档 (英文) （如果页面显示"时限过期"，请重新单击或重新下载） 更多资讯如下 966号刊物 -《联邦电子缴税系统：入门指南》 (英文) PDF 4990号刊物 -《企业与个人纳税人的 EFTPS 付款指示小册》(英文) PDF 5301，联邦电子缴税系统 -- 批量提供商软件用户手册 (英文) PDF EFTPS ®在线资源，可通过电话订购(英文) 付款主页 上的更多电子和其他付款选项 目前冒充国税局的诈骗和钓鱼网站 Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 10-Nov-2026 Share Facebook Twitter Linkedin Print

pages.description: 전자식 연방세 납부 시스템(EFTPS)은 미국 재무부에서 납세자의 연방 세금 납부를 위해 무료로 제공하는 시스템입니다. EFTPS에 대한 설명과 사용방법에 대해 알아보십시오.

EFTPS 는 다음을 제공합니다: 신뢰할 수 있는 보안 안전한 인터넷 브라우저에서 납세자 식별 번호 ( EIN 또는 SSN ), 개인 식별 번호 ( PIN ) 및 인터넷 암호, 그리고 안전한 인터넷 브라우저를 병용하여 보안이 강화됩니다. 언제든 이용 가능한 편리성 납부일을 365일 까지 미리 예약할 수 있습니다. 집이나 사무실에서 언제든지 세금을 납부할 수 있습니다. 귀하의 소득, 고용, 연방세 중간예납 및 연방 특별 소비세를 납부할 수 있습니다. 예약된 세금 납부를 쉽게 변경하거나 취소할 수 있습니다. 이메일 알림으로 납부 상황을 추적할 수 있습니다. 지난 15개월 동안의 납부 내역을 확인할 수 있습니다. 고객 서비스 안내원으로부터 납부 또는 질문에 대한 도움을 받을 수 있습니다. 신뢰할 수 있는 정확성 귀하의 납부에 대한 즉각적 확인 내역과 귀하의 은행 명세서를 검토하여 납부 사실을 확인할 수 있습니다. 다수의 고객의 세금 납부를 할 수 있는 수용력 세무 전문가는, 단일 로그인으로 다수 고객의 세금을 납부할 수 있습니다. 무료 Batch Provider Software (일괄처리 제공자 소프트웨어)를 다운로드하십시오(영어) . 간행물 5301, 전자 연방 세금 납부 시스템 – 일괄처리 제공자 소프트웨어 사용자 매뉴얼(영어) PDF EFTPS 등록 방법 신규 EFTPS 등록은 업무일수로 최대 5일이 소요됩니다. El citomegalovirus en los recién nacidos 17 de ene. del 2025 English (US) Puntos clave Cuando un bebé nace con la infección por citomegalovirus (CMV), se dice que tiene citomegalovirus congénito. El citomegalovirus es la causa infecciosa más común de defectos de nacimiento en los Estados Unidos. La mayoría de los bebés con citomegalovirus congénito nunca muestran signos ni tienen problemas de salud, pero algunos los presentan al nacer o más adelante. Cómo se propaga El citomegalovirus se propaga a través del contacto con líquidos corporales . Los niños pequeños a menudo tienen citomegalovirus Los niños pequeños son una fuente común de citomegalovirus. Para los 5 años, 1 de cada 3 niños ha sido infectado por citomegalovirus, pero generalmente no tiene síntomas. Grandes cantidades del virus pueden permanecer en los líquidos corporales del niño, como la saliva y la orina, durante meses después de la infección. Converging waves of weather – floods, cyclones and extreme heat – forecast to peak in the coming months will prove fatal for many, especially pregnant women, who face being cut off from hospital when in labour. About 15 million babies are due to be born in November and December in countries rated as high risk for El Niño – that represents two in every three births worldwide. Electronic Reporting Requirements for Certain Information under the Toxic Substances Control Act On this page Final Rule Report electronically Subject to e-reporting Other Resources Final Rule On December 4, 2013 EPA finalized a rule to require electronic reporting of certain information submitted to the Agency under the Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA). The final rule follows two previous rules requiring similar electronic reporting of information submitted to EPA (for TSCA Chemical Data Reporting and for Pre-Manufacture Notifications ), and is intended to save time, improve data quality and increase efficiency. Elizabeth Urbanas Beth Urbanas is the Deputy Assistant Secretary for Asia and the Americas at the Office of International Affairs in the U.S. Department of Energy. Ms. Urbanas is responsible for managing DOE’s bilateral and multilateral engagement with Asian and American countries. She is also responsible for DOE's work in several multilateral fora including the North American Leaders' Summit, the Energy and Climate Partnership of the Americas, and APEC. Ms. Urbanas has also been a lead negotiator in the USMCA and the Indo-Pacific Economic Framework focusing on Energy and Clean Economy. Prior to her current position, she was the Director for European and Eurasian Affairs at the Office of International Affairs in the U.S. Department of Energy. In this role she was also responsible for DOE's work in the G20 and G7. Prior to working at DOE, Ms. Urbanas spent 14 years at the U.S. Treasury Department where she created and directed the Office of Environment and Energy. She was also instrumental in the design of the Climate Investment Funds and the Green Climate Fund, where she represented the United States on the boards. Pronghorn antelope, mule deer, Rocky Mountain elk, wild horses, domestic cattle and sheep are a few of the larger animals you might see in this area. The southern region includes species uniquely adapted to the Mojave desert, including desert tortoise, kit fox, roadrunners or desert bighorn sheep. Some of the desert plants are yucca, cholla cacti and Joshua trees. pages.text: Employee Polygraph Protection Act | U.S. Department of Labor Skip to main content Employee Polygraph Protection Act The Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) prohibits most private employers from using lie detector tests, either for pre-employment screening or during the course of employment. Employers generally may not require or request any employee or job applicant to take a lie detector test, or discharge, discipline, or discriminate against an employee or job applicant for refusing to take a test or for exercising other rights under the Act. Employers may not use or inquire about the results of a lie detector test or discharge or discriminate against an employee or job applicant on the basis of the results of a test, or for filing a complaint, or for participating in a proceeding under the Act. Subject to restrictions, the Act permits polygraph (a type of lie detector) tests to be administered to certain job applicants of security service firms (armored car, alarm, and guard) and of pharmaceutical manufacturers, distributors and dispensers. Subject to restrictions, the Act also permits polygraph testing of certain employees of private firms who are reasonably suspected of involvement in a workplace incident (theft, embezzlement, etc.) that resulted in specific economic loss or injury to the employer. pages.text: Employers and the ADA: Myths and Facts | U.S. Department of Labor Skip to main content Employers and the ADA: Myths and Facts The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) is a landmark federal law that protects the rights of people with disabilities by eliminating barriers to their participation in many aspects of living and working in America. In particular, the ADA prohibits covered employers from discriminating against people with disabilities in the full range of employment-related activities, from recruitment to advancement, to pay and benefits. The foundation for the ADA is America's promise of equal access to opportunity for all citizens. Being supportive of people with disabilities — in recruitment, retention, promotion, and in providing an accessible environment — gives businesses a competitive edge. Below are some of the common myths about how the ADA affects employers and research and facts that negate them. Myth : The ADA forces employers to hire unqualified individuals with disabilities. Fact : Applicants who are unqualified for a job cannot claim discrimination under the ADA. Under the ADA, to be protected from discrimination in hiring, an individual with a disability must be qualified, which means he or she must meet all requirements for a job and be able to perform its essential functions with or without reasonable accommodations. pages.text: Employment Rights: Who has Them and Who Enforces Them | U.S. Department of Labor Skip to main content Employment Rights: Who has Them and Who Enforces Them Individuals with disabilities are protected from discrimination in employment primarily by two federal laws. The Americans with Disabilities Act (Public Law 101-336), enacted into law on July 26, 1990, prohibits private sector employers who employ 15 or more individuals and all State and local government employers from discriminating against qualified individuals with disabilities in all aspects of employment. The Rehabilitation Act of 1973 (Public Law 93-112), as amended, prohibits discrimination in employment in three areas. Section 501 of the Rehabilitation Act prohibits federal executive branch agencies, including the U.S. Postal Service and the Postal Rate Commission, from discriminating against qualified individuals with disabilities. It requires executive branch agencies to take affirmative action in the hiring, placing and advancing of individuals with disabilities. Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act requires contractors who have a contract with the federal government for $10,000 or more, and their subcontractors who have subcontracts satisfying the same criteria, to take affirmative action to employ and to advance in employment qualified individuals with disabilities. Section 504 prohibits recipients of federal financial assistance from discriminating against qualified individuals with disabilities in employment and in their programs and activities. Unlike static materials, biological systems and processes can be difficult to measure because they are always changing. NIST develops solutions for these measurement problems to help the U.S. maintain leadership of the global bioeconomy . Engineering biology, also known as synthetic biology, enables the intentional design, manufacture and deployment of living cells, cell systems, and other biological processes to create materials and products that benefit us, like crops that resist drought and pests, renewable energy sources, advanced medicines, and more. NIST’s measurement science and other technical activities support robust innovation and more sustainable manufacturing practices in distributed manufacturing centers, which help alleviate supply chain disruptions for synthetic biology’s most-needed products, like commodity chemicals and materials, and medicines.
